per_solve.wall: median_s of the KS_N7_MEASURE line of the process with 1 + N solves (the per-solve median timed inside the process; preparation outside)

order: cells 256x256 then 128x128x64; rounds 1 and 3: complex then paired; round 2: paired then complex; within an arm: solves 1 then 1 + N
load_rule: no waiting; the 1-minute load average is recorded before every process. The wall ratio of a cell is decidable if every process it uses started at load <= 3.0, or if the ratio is <= 0.3 or >= 1.2 (a factor-2 margin around the thresholds 0.6 and 1.0); otherwise it is NOT_DECIDABLE.
statistic: ratio = median over rounds of paired median_s / median over rounds of complex median_s; per-round ratios reported; the instruction ratio and the analytic FFT-line ratio (0.502 at 256x256, from the builder's notes) are reported, not decided on

verdict.PASS: decidable and ratio <= 0.6 at 256x256, and every KS_N7_MEASURE line has max_backward_error <= 1e-13
verdict.NOT_DECIDABLE: the wall ratio at 256x256 is not decidable
verdict.INVALID: a process failed or a backward error exceeds 1e-13
verdict.after_PASS: the default may change to PairedReal only after review finding F5 is closed (the transform recorded in SeparableReport or the client id); that change is a separate commit with its own tests
